output.recommendation: Policy should be developed requiring telecom operators to adhere to data governance practices similar to those outlined in EU-AIACT-2024 Article 10(2) for retraining network AI models, ensuring that subscriber location traces are used lawfully and transparently.
output.rationale: [G1] EU-AIACT-2024 Article 10(2): 'Training, validation and testing data sets shall be subject to data governance and management practices appropriate' — EU: training/validation/testing data sets of high-risk AI must follow data-governance practices
